<thought>The mass spectrum shows a clear M+1 peak at ~20 % of the monoisotopic intensity and a rapidly decreasing series of higher‑mass peaks. Such a pattern is characteristic of the natural ¹³C isotopic contribution (≈1.1 % per carbon atom), indicating a substantial number of carbon atoms. No other element (e.g., Cl, Br, S) exhibits a distinctive isotopic spacing or relative intensity matching this pattern, so carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
